what_was_requested: Test the Xbox Game Activity entry point by navigating from the dashboard through the Guide to Game Activity, then opening and returning from Achievements, Stats, and the official club, finally returning to the dashboard. All game names and content must remain visible at each destination, and no error dialogs should appear.
what_was_attempted: The test successfully navigated to Game Activity, opened Achievements (showing game name and achievement content), returned to Game Activity, opened Stats (showing game name and statistics), returned to Game Activity, and opened the official club (showing game name and club content). However, when pressing B to return from the official club, the console jumped directly to the Xbox Dashboard Home instead of returning to Game Activity first. The executor then aborted with a safety check to prevent blind tapping on the dashboard.
verdict_statement: FAIL. The test did not complete the required navigation sequence. After opening the official club and pressing B, the console returned directly to the Dashboard Home instead of returning to Game Activity as specified in the success criteria. The scenario explicitly requires returning to Game Activity after each destination before returning to the dashboard. The run aborted at step 32 when the executor detected an unexpected state (dashboard home instead of game context).

rca_summary: The Xbox console exhibited unexpected navigation behavior: pressing B from the official club page returned directly to the Dashboard Home instead of returning to the Game Activity menu. The rig was healthy and responsive throughout the test — all inputs were received and acted upon (confirmed by consistent screen changes at steps 2, 7, 11, 15, 19, 23, 27, and 31). The GIMX session successfully delivered inputs (Guide, A, B buttons all produced expected screen changes). This is a product defect in the console's UI navigation logic, not a rig failure. The same B button press worked correctly when returning from Achievements and Stats, but failed when returning from the official club, suggesting either a console bug specific to the official club page or an issue with the navigation stack in that context.
recommended_next_action: Manually verify the navigation behavior on the console: (1) Open Guide → Game Activity → Achievements → press B (should return to Game Activity). (2) From Game Activity, open Stats → press B (should return to Game Activity). (3) From Game Activity, open Go to official club → press B and observe the result. Repeat this sequence 3 times to check for consistency. If pressing B from the official club consistently returns to Dashboard Home instead of Game Activity, file a product defect bug against the Xbox console firmware. If it sometimes returns to Game Activity, increase the wait time in the test before pressing B to allow the page to fully load. Clarify the test scenario specification to explicitly document the expected navigation path and whether Game Activity must be visited between the official club and the dashboard.
